description_en: Transfers a call to an agent by using a single-step or two-step transfer
description_zh: 通话单\双步转交到坐席
kebab_example: aliyun scsp transfer-call-to-agent --client-token 46c1341e-2648-447a-9b11-70b6a298d94d --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name 123@123.com --target-account-name 345@123.com --call-id 7719786 --job-id 7719787 --connection-id 7719788 --hold-connection-id 0 --type 1 --is-single-transfer true --region cn-hangzhou
name: TransferCallToAgent

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the client request. This parameter is used for idempotence verification. You can use a UUID to generate the value
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent account (agent logon name)
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称（坐席登录名）
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the target agent account (agent logon name) to which the call is transferred
parameters.help_zh: 转交坐席账号名称（坐席登录名）
parameters.name: target_account_name

parameters.help_en: The acid in the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en: The jobId in the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The connId in the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received
parameters.name: connection_id

parameters.help_en: The holdConnId in the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received. This parameter is required only for two-step transfers
parameters.help_zh: 入呼后，websocket中的holdConnId（仅在双步转时传入）
parameters.name: hold_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The transfer type. Valid values:
- 1: single-step transfer
- 2: two-step transfer
Default value: 1
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a single-step transfer. Valid values:
- true: Single-step transfer.
- false: Two-step transfer.
Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: true:单步转，false:双步转，默认单步转
parameters.name: is_single_transfer
